OS01.ticket: Overnight bookings should bill the elapsed time across midnight. Make duration require an explicit day length so callers choose their clock. Both booking quotes and invoices use 24-hour days. Keep same-day behavior.

files.span.py:
def duration(start, end):
    return end - start
files.diagnostics.py:
def duration(first, last):
    return last - first

reference.span.py:
def duration(start, end, *, day):
    return (end - start) % day if end < start else end - start

incomplete.span.py:
def duration(start, end, *, day):
    return (end - start) % day if end < start else end - start

OS01.oracle:
from bookings import booking_hours
from statements import amount_due
from span import duration
import inspect
assert booking_hours(22, 2) == 4
assert amount_due(22, 2) == 32
assert amount_due(2, 6) == 32
assert inspect.signature(duration).parameters['day'].default is inspect.Parameter.empty

OS03.oracle:
from stats import measure
from api import public_summary
from rows import export_row

OS04.ticket: When extracting nonempty tags, skip entries that contain whitespace only. Keep surrounding whitespace on nonempty entries and preserve input order.

files.tags.py:
def nonempty_tags(tags):
    return [tag for tag in tags if tag]

reference.tags.py:
